Definition: the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal, of the sole, and even of the bowl of a dish or sling, the handle of a bolt, the leaves of a palm-tree); figuratively, power
BiblicalUsage: 1) palm, hand, sole, palm of the hand, hollow or flat of the hand; 1a) palm, hollow or flat of the hand; 1b) power; 1c) sole (of the foot); 1d) hollow, objects, bending objects, bent objects; 1d1) of thigh-joint; 1d2) pan, vessel (as hollow); 1d3) hollow (of sling); 1d4) hand-shaped branches or fronds (of palm trees); 1d5) handles (as bent)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
